title: Sculptures
fullDescription: A personal collection of six intricate sculptures created using ZBrush, 3ds Max, and Photoshop. Each sculpture represents a fusion of traditional art techniques with modern digital sculpting. Turntable videos on YouTube showcase the full 360° view of these pieces, emphasizing texture, detail, and form.  httpswww.youtube.com@echendeligani1799
